description.value:
Aspect time

Prerequisite The relic is 5th level or higher.

Activate 2 concentrate, manipulate

Frequency once per hour

Effect You target one creature within 30 feet, temporarily imposing the decrepitude of time on it. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled] conditions last 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 3}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 2}.
